Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small game HUD micro-menu icon for Vandrheim.
The three supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image 1 is the existing spellbook icon, image 2 equipment, image 3 talents. Match this family closely: simple clean illustrated shapes, warm brass gold #C89445, warm parchment cream #F4EDE0, dark charcoal #292A2E or leather brown, thick clean dark outlines and only restrained flat shading. No photorealism, ornate item illustration, 3D render, glow, sparkle, gritty texture, smoky black patches or drop shadows. Forms should remain bold and distinguishable at 24–32 pixels.
Generate ONE icon only on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, NOT the black backdrop of the style reference files. No surrounding badge, tile, border, UI, text, letters or numbers. Square image with the complete icon centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, generous even transparent margins. Isolated standalone icon, clean alpha edges. Favor 2–3 large shapes over many small decorative details.
Subject: a compact arched dungeon entrance made of dark slate stone blocks with a warm brass outline. The arch and a simple three-bar brass portcullis are unmistakable. One parchment-colored keystone and restrained parchment edge highlights. Dark open passage inside the arch, represented by transparent negative space. Broad stone arch silhouette, thick bars with generous gaps. Front three-quarter angle only very slight, similar to the existing spellbook/equipment icon. No towers, landscape, torches, skull, weapon, scroll, stairs outside the silhouette, or tiny masonry details. This opens the dungeon panel.
